about: Lookups of the people tables (tools/newworld/stockdb.py). Add a row here before a person uses it.

person_role.about: Lives and works in the place; no service the place promises.
Keeps the peace: a member of the place's guard (in Black Marsh, often a tribal levy).
Works the forge and sells arms and armour (trader-blacksmith).
Sells spell tomes and magic goods (trader-spells).
Keeps the inn, sells food and drink, rents a bed.
Carries travellers by boat for a fare (carriage-or-boat).
Holds the place or speaks for it.

household_role.about: Heads the household; one per household.
A grown child of the head or partner.
A parent or elder of the head or partner.
A sibling of the head or partner.
Further kin living under the roof.
Lives under the roof without being kin.
A guard of the levy quartered with the household.

relation_kind.about: The first is a parent of the second.
The first works for the second.
The first owes the second a debt or a favour.
